title: Graham Hancock's first article on the Ark of the Covenant

tellings.quote: interviewed Graham Hancock and his the first piece that he ever did was it was like for a I think a magazine or something and he was writing an article on the ark of the covenant.

plain: Jesse Michels, a podcast host, recalls that the writer Graham Hancock told him his very first piece of writing was a magazine article about the Ark of the Covenant, the sacred chest from the Bible said to hold the Ten Commandments. Michels mentions it as an early sign of Hancock's lifelong pull toward ancient mysteries.
